info.title: l3lint
info.description: l3lint command-line tool: lints commercial card Level 2 and Level 3 payloads against Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover requirements before submission, and explains each likely downgrade and its fix. Offline; never transmits data.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: l3lint lints commercial card Level 2 and Level 3 payloads against Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover requirements, offline.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Turn off color. NO_COLOR also turns it off. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Print less: no progress notes and no passing results. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print more: settings notes and stack traces for internal errors. [default: False]

options.name: --log-level
options.description: Log level: error, warn, info, debug or trace. Default: warn. [default: warn]

options.name: --log-format
options.description: Log format: text or json. Logs go to standard error. [default: text]

options.name: --log-values
options.description: Include masked payload values in logs. Off by default. [default: False]

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Lint payload files, folders, globs, NDJSON or standard input.

options.name: --format
options.description: Input format: auto, canonical, stripe, adyen, braintree, cybersource, authorizenet, checkoutcom or csv. Default: auto.

options.name: --map
options.description: Column map for CSV input.

options.name: --currency
options.description: ISO 4217 currency for payloads that carry none, such as Braintree requests. Payload values win.

options.name: --brand
options.description: Card brand to lint against: auto, visa, mastercard, amex, discover or all. Default: auto (reads card.brand).

options.name: --card-product
options.description: Card product, overriding the payload: consumer, business, corporate, purchasing, fleet or commercialPrepaid.

options.name: --mcc
options.description: Merchant category code, 4 digits, overriding the payload.

options.name: --merchant-country
options.description: Merchant country, ISO alpha-2. Default: US.

options.name: --processor
options.description: Processor profile name or path to a profile YAML file. Default: generic.

options.name: --as-of
options.description: Lint against the rules in force on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the transaction date, else today.

options.name: --config
options.description: Config file. Default: the nearest .l3lint.yaml walking up from the current folder.

options.name: --rule-pack
options.description: Folder of a rule pack to load in addition to the embedded packs. Repeatable.

options.name: --only
options.description: Run only these rule IDs or globs. Repeatable.

options.name: --disable
options.description: Rule IDs or globs to skip, for example VISA-DQ-*. Repeatable.

options.name: --severity
options.description: Severity override as RULE=level, for example GEN-DQ-007=error. Repeatable.

options.name: --rates
options.description: Rate table YAML that enables cost estimates.

options.name: --strict-pci
options.description: Stop when a card number is found instead of masking it. [default: False]

options.name: --strict-profiles
options.description: Run single-processor rules as errors. [default: False]

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Lowest severity that sets exit code 1: error, warning, information or none. Default: error.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output kind: text, json, sarif, junit or markdown. Use kind=path to write a file. Repeatable.

options.name: --max-findings
options.description: Most findings to print. The summary still counts every finding.

options.name: --annotations
options.description: Also print GitHub workflow annotations for findings at or above --fail-on: github or none. [default: none]

arguments.name: INPUTS
arguments.description: Files, folders, globs such as fixtures/**/*.json, NDJSON files, or - for standard input.
